# Costa et. al
# See Materials and Methods for additional information on annotation derivation

# gene: systematic gene name
# name: common gene name
# secretome: whether gene is a member of the secretome
# srp_dept: whether gene is predicted to be SRP-dependent, SRP-independent, or Internal
# tailanchor: whether this gene is annotated as tailanchor
# mitop2: whether gene is a member of the mitop2 reference set
# chx_dept: whether gene is predicted as CHX-dependent or CHX-independent for ER enrichment
# amino_acid_length: length of gene in amino acids
# hydrophobic_start: position, in amino acids, where the first Phobius-predicted hydrophobic feature begins
# first_hydrophobic_type: whether first Phobius-predicted hydrophobic feature is signal peptide (SP) or transmembrane domain (TMD)
# hydrophobic features: all Phobius-predicted hydrophobic features throughout length of protein
# For a given sequencing experiment:
#	The first portion indicates the protein to which BirA was fused
#	'XmAuxin' indicates X minutes of auxin treatment prior to biotinylation
#	'XmCHX' indicates X minutes of CHX pre-treatment (in addition to biotinylation time)
#	'XmBiotin' indicates X minutes of biotinylation time
#	'input' represents the whole cell ribosome profiling library
#	'pulldown' represents a biotin pulldown ribosome profiling library
#	'cts' refers to the number of sequencing reads that mapped to the gene
#	'rpkm' is reads per kilobase per million, which corrects counts for total sequencing reads in the library and gene length
#	'log2enrich' represents log2(*pulldown_rpkm/*input_rpkm)
#
